parts.label: Nail plate
parts.description: The curved, translucent keratin plate protects the nail bed below.

parts.label: Nail bed
parts.description: The vascular tissue beneath the plate contributes to its visible color. Pallor is illustrated here.

parts.label: Nail matrix
parts.description: The proximal matrix produces the nail plate. Its visible distal portion forms the lunula.

parts.label: Skin and nail folds
parts.description: The proximal and lateral folds surround and protect the edges of the nail plate.

parts.label: Cuticle
parts.description: The thin seal extending from the proximal fold adheres to the nail plate.

parts.label: Distal phalanx
parts.description: The fingertip bone supports the nail unit and the surrounding soft tissues.

parts.label: Fingertip pulp
parts.description: Connective tissue and the padded fingertip surround the supporting bone.

parts.label: Blood vessels
parts.description: Small vessels supply the nail unit and fingertip. This vascular pattern is illustrative.
